FL-002.label: Memory units have a length cap; a memory over the cap is shortened to fit as one memory, and it is split only when it holds more than one distinct fact, with the split logged.
FL-002.walk: Save an over-cap single fact: shorten it into one memory, preserving its schedule and qualifiers; split only independent claims. Repeat the scout's long single-fact and two-fact inputs three times. The same prompt repairs failed checks up to three rounds; nothing is dropped silently and the original stays in the journal (M5RM / F208).
FL-002.observed: Three original scout long/two-fact pairs each saved one/two active facts. Long bodies: 87, 47, 60 cl100k tokens. Final original input and output remain in the journal. Wrenfield has conflicting monthly/fortnightly wording in the source; final body preserves its opening rather than claiming to reconcile it. See count-1..3 receipts; discarded iterations retained.

FL-014.label: Every memory records the folder the agent stood in when it was made.
FL-014.walk: `/remember` while the agent stands in a folder; the card shows that folder as WHERE.
FL-014.observed: The remembered theatre fact shows its actual creation folder under WHERE in the visible provenance popup.

FL-038.label: A cheap 80/20 duplicate check at memory creation, keeping the agent's memory work under 10% of build run time.
FL-038.walk: Save a fact already in the Palace: at cosine 0.92 or above the save comes back 'already known — reinforced' at once, between 0.80 and 0.92 it asks to confirm, without the agent reading other memories; these write-time bands are the C.4 defaults and are separate from the curator's own search band (v2.128).
FL-038.observed: Exact and close rewordings reinforced, and a 0.868 candidate asked for consent; the under-ten-percent build-time requirement was not measured. Screenshot is context only, not feature proof.

FL-042.label: Constitution: 'Already known — reinforced' on re-saves; rejected candidates remembered and never re-proposed without material change (gate-day).
FL-042.walk: Re-save a known fact; the reply says 'already known — reinforced'; reject a candidate and re-save it unchanged; it is not proposed again.
FL-042.observed: Known fact reinforced. A rejected seed was refused on exact /remember and omitted on reupload; the original draft remained with the actual rejection reason.

FL-044.label: At compaction the summarizing agent turns anything important but not needed for the next few build steps into a memory through the normal memory creation path, and compaction waits for those memories to land before dropping the rest.
FL-044.walk: Cross a compaction on a main thread: every fact a continuing agent would want lands as its own self-contained memory (no count cap; shorten one over-long claim, split only independent claims), a curator pass follows and merges them with what the Palace already holds, the last share of the conversation is still there word for word, the next prompt's injection can draw on the new facts, and the whole original chat is still on record beside the facts drawn from it (owner, 2026-10-05, v2.133; M5RM).
FL-044.observed: Charged F194 corner: three original scout compactions on one principal completed, retained the original span and verbatim tail, approved all proposed cards, completed the following curator pass and answered the next prompt. Three extra exact-label fixtures all approved with unchanged facts and distinct project-qualified labels. These extra fixtures were API-created, not model-generated; approvals used the app endpoint as in the scout. Does not close the separate F206 reliability finding. Public 0.1.73 approval and continuation also succeeded, but seven writes-triggered curator passes failed before one completed; no compaction-triggered completion was observed within the 180-second wait. Thus the wider row retains FAIL despite F194 being resolved. SQL run receipts and public walk are retained.
